summary: A 16x16 ft frame cabin built in 1952 for the Idaho Department of Lands, abandoned in 1983; sources disagree on whether it still stands.

facts.status_note: The cabin was abandoned as a lookout in 1983. Sources disagree on whether it still stands; the summit is now a radio site.

access.note: The approach road crosses private and timber-company land, and the last owner strictly forbids access. The summit land is retained by the State of Idaho.

notes_for_editor: Status is the open question. The record's 'gone' matches the FFLA list and Peakbagging, but Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com say the cabin now houses communication equipment, which may mean it still stands; Willhite says demolition date is unknown. A human should decide the status note before publishing. Ownership is 'unknown' in the record, but the summit land is state-retained per Willhite. Access is private: the story advises against going up without permission. Do not confuse with the Washington Mica Peak (FFLOS US 1509, WA 409, Spokane County), cached under data/raw/fflos/firetower.org/lookouts/us/wa/mica-peak-lookout-site/. No new photos added.
